title: Benjamin Berman - Tips, Tricks and History for Card Game Roguelike Design
speaker: Benjamin Berman
talk_title: Tips, Tricks and History for Card Game Roguelike Design
description:
This talk is from the 2019 Roguelike Celebration - find out more at https://roguelike.club/event2019.html

Creator of Spellsource, a community authored card game, and MonsterMatch, a monster dating game. Former MIT Media Lab games researcher.
